ctx.x: I told Angy method. I told Angy. Yeah. I told Angy method right here. Yeah. I know that. I told Angy. I went through old Angy with the and the old man took sick right and I had about one or two pages left and I went with Piku. Oh really? Yeah. I went with Piku and took about two or three lessons with Piku finishing that book. The old man took sick. Yeah I was about 19 years old.
How was Piku? Was he a good teacher? Who? Piku. Was he a good teacher?
